description: Ask a seller to price a bulk order. No sign-in required. Signed-in buyers can omit buyer_email; it defaults to the account email, which is where the seller replies. Anonymous callers must pass buyer_email. Anonymous requests are limited to 5 per hour. Save status_token and pass it to get_quote_status. This does not charge a card. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

buyer_email.description: Where the seller replies. Required when the caller is not signed in. Optional when signed in; defaults to the account email.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731. productId, id, and slug are aliases.

slug.description: Alias for product_id. Public listing slug.

target_price.description: Target price per unit in cents (optional)

name: request_quote

expected_response.description: What happens next. The seller is notified. There is no guaranteed reply time.

target_price.description: Buyer target per unit, as supplied.

status_token.description: Pass to get_quote_status to read this quote back. Keep it: an anonymous caller has no other way in.

title: Request a bulk quote
